mapper.select: SELECT cd.name AS diseaseName, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS count FROM adm_encounter e INNER JOIN adm_encounter_diagnosis ed ON e.id = ed.encounter_id AND ed.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN cln_condition c ON ed.condition_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN cln_condition_definition cd ON c.definition_id = cd.id AND cd.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY cd.name ORDER BY count DESC
